chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a gentle waltz call on the night air: a lone bell-buoy chime, then the accordion lead sways in with the first rising phrase of the waltz and leans onto the home chord, leading into the theme}
positive_styles: soft accordion-like pulse-wave lead with a lilting waltz melody
sparse bell-buoy chimes ringing into the gaps
slow rocking waltz bass, root then gentle fifths
seaside town late at night, lanterns swaying between masts, wistful and lonely but cosy

chunks.text:
[Main Theme]
{the waltz melody in D minor, bare and swaying, the rising lift landing on each downbeat and settling back over beats two and three; hummable and clear}
positive_styles: soft accordion-like pulse-wave lead with a lilting waltz melody

chunks.text:
[Main Theme Reprise]
{the same waltz again with a soft flute counter-line answering each phrase, strings a little fuller, the bells ringing into the gaps}
positive_styles: soft accordion-like pulse-wave lead with a lilting waltz melody

chunks.text:
[Bridge]
{contrast: a warmer turn to F major, like a lit window up on the hill, the melody rising higher and kinder, then drifting back down toward the minor}

chunks.text:
[Main Theme Return]
{the waltz returns in D minor, calm and swaying; the last bar sways straight back into the theme, no ending}
